contests.title: Kingsland — lower age for senior homestead exemption

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption of $25,000.00 from City of Kingsland ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for residents 62 years of age or older, which represents a three-year decrease in age to qualify for such exemption?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption of $25,000.00 from City of Kingsland ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for residents 62 years of age or older, which represents a three-year decrease in age to qualify for such exemption?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption of $25,000.00 from City of Kingsland ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for residents 62 years of age or older, which represents a three-year decrease in age to qualify for such exemption?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Lowers the qualifying age for Kingsland’s $25,000 city-tax homestead exemption by three years, from 65 to 62. The exemption removes $25,000 of a qualifying resident’s assessed homestead value from city property taxation, including city bond taxes. If voters approve, the lower age takes effect January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve eligibility at age 62 for the $25,000 city-tax homestead exemption.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject lowering the qualifying age from 65 to 62.
